programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Rapazes Nas Árvores
programme.desc: Na noite de Halloween de 1997, Corey, Jango e o restante grupo de skaters despedem-se do liceu, mas o primeiro reencontra Jonah, seu amigo da escola primária, vítima de crueldade por parte do segundo, e o percurso de ambos de regresso a casa torna-se cada vez mais estranho e assustador.

programme.title: Um Mercado De Milhões
programme.desc: O futebol dos nossos dias é uma indústria global onde estão em jogo milhares de milhões de euros. Driss Berzane é um agente de jogadores à beira da falência, que tem apenas sete dias até ao encerramento do mercado de transferências para conseguir pagar uma dívida de 300 mil euros.

programme.title: Call Jane Tu Não Estás Só
programme.desc: Na Chicago dos anos 60, uma mulher casada e feliz vê sua vida virada do avesso quando tem uma gravidez que coloca um sério risco à sua própria vida. Sem hipótese de a interromper de forma legal, ela acaba por entrar em contacto com um grupo de mulheres que lhe oferece ajuda, as Jane.

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Cosmoball - Os Jogadores Da Galáxia
programme.desc: Uma enorme nave espacial ergue-se acima da Terra é uma espécie de estádio para um jogo vagamente parecido com o futebol moderno, mas a velocidades incrivelmente altas. Este é um jogo de bola espacial e quando o jogo começa, o mundo pára para ver.

programme.title: Tango E Cash
programme.desc: Dois polícias de Los Angeles, o aprumado Ray Tango e o desalinhado Gabriel Cash, caem numa cilada do seu implacável arqui-inimigo e são colocados atrás das grades. Agora, vão ter de deixar para trás as suas diferenças e trabalharem juntos para poderem sobreviver e provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Fortaleza
programme.desc: Robert vive numa espécie de estância natural criada para oficiais reformados dos serviços secretos dos EUA. Quando um grupo de criminosos invade o complexo com intenções de o matar, ele vai ter de encontrar um modo de proteger as vidas de todos os que lá se encontram.

programme.title: Dartagnan, O 4 Mosqueteiro
programme.desc: A pedido do seu pai, o jovem DArtagnan viaja da Gasconha rural para Paris para se tornar mosqueteiro e acaba envolvido numa conspiração do traidor Conde Rochefort contra o Rei Luís XIV, juntando-se aos três célebres mosqueteiros para deter os inimigos da coroa.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Esta é a história do ataque terrorista ao luxuoso Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, em Bombaim, no ano de 2008. No meio do caos, os funcionários do hotel arriscam a vida para manterem todos a salvo e fazem sacrifícios impensáveis para se protegerem a si e às suas famílias.

programme.title: The Contractor Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: Hardcore
programme.desc: Henry é ressuscitado da morte sem memória do seu passado e tem de salvar a sua mulher de um senhor da guerra com poderes de telecinesia, um exército de mercenários e um plano para dominar o mundo.

programme.title: Sem Tempo A Perder
programme.desc: Em Lyon, em 1942, um pequeno grupo resistentes franceses usa a rádio para transmitir mensagens de esperança aos outros sobreviventes, tentando não ser descobertos pela Gestapo.

programme.title: A Minha Grande Noite
programme.desc: Jose é enviado por uma agência de trabalho para colaborar na gravação do programa de televisão Especial de Ano Novo, a meio de Agosto. Centenas de pessoas fingem rir-se e celebrar a falsa passagem de ano uma e outra vez Ninguém está feliz

programme.title: Batalha Incerta
programme.desc: Em plena crise económica americana da década de 1930, Jim e Mac, dois ativistas, infiltram-se num grupo de trabalhadores agrícolas a quem apenas é pago um terço do ordenado prometido, e ajudam-nos a organizarem-se para que sejam bem sucedidos na luta pelos seus direitos através de uma greve.

programme.title: Belle
programme.desc: Suzu é uma discreta estudante japonesa de 17 anos que um dia entra em U, um universo virtual com cinco mil milhões de membros, onde deixa de ser Suzu para ser Belle, uma cantora mundialmente famosa. Aí conhece uma criatura misteriosa com a qual embarca numa viagem de aventuras, desafios e amor.

programme.title: O Amor E A Vida Real
programme.desc: Dan Burns é um colunista, especialista em aconselhamento familiar, mas com dificuldade em sobreviver como irmão e como pai viúvo de três filhas precoces. As coisas tornam-se ainda mais complicadas quando Dan descobre que a sua apaixonada secreta é na realidade a nova namorada do irmão

programme.title: O Espaço Que Nos Une
programme.desc: O primeiro humano nascido em Marte viaja à Terra pela primeira vez aos 16 anos e vive extasiado todas maravilhas do planeta. Quando foge dos seus protetores e parte em busca do pai, segue viagem com a rapariga por quem se apaixonou mas que não sabe a verdade sobre ele.

programme.title: Shenandoah - O Vale Da Honra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra Civil americana, um fazendeiro da Virgínia jurou permanecer neutral no conflito, mas quando o seu filho mais velho é feito prisioneiro pelos soldados da União ele é forçado a agir.

programme.title: Arqui-inimigo
programme.desc: Um adolescente encontra um homem misterioso chamado Max Fist, que diz ter perdido os seus super-poderes após chegar à Terra vindo de outra dimensão. Ninguém acredita nele exceto o rapaz, e juntos vão tentar enfrentar um barão do crime e desmantelar o seu negócio de tráfico de droga.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola
programme.desc: John Kimble é um polícia de Los Angeles que tem de se infiltrar numa comunidade como professor de um jardim infantil para localizar a ex-mulher do perigoso criminoso que ele quer colocar atrás das grades.

programme.title: Regresso Ao Futuro Parte II
programme.desc: Marty e Doc viajam até 2015 para resolver alguns problemas com o futuro da família McFly. Mas quando regressam, apercebem-se que a realidade de 1985 que conheciam foi completamente alterada. A única esperança agora é regressar a 1955 para conseguir salvar o futuro.

programme.title: 47 Ronin - A Grande Batalha Samurai
programme.desc: Nada menos que 47 samurais sem líder prometem vingança depois de um traiçoeiro senhor da guerra lhes ter morto o mestre e os ter banido. O bando de Ronin procura agora a ajuda de Kai um mestiço que eles haviam rejeitado enquanto enfrentam um mundo de bestas míticas e bruxarias assombrosas.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Cano Serrado
programme.desc: Na região Centro-Oeste do Brasil, uma vasta ecorregião de savana tropical chamada Cerrado, o sargento Sebastião fará tudo para vingar o seu irmão, um caminhoneiro morto brutalmente, mas confunde dois policiais da cidade com os suspeitos do crime.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 4, Op. 18, No. 4
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Stravinsky, Webern and Debussy
programme.desc: Today’s Brussels Philharmonic concert focuses on the diverse musical styles that characterized the first half of the 20th century. In addition to the impressionism of Claude Debussy's Jeux (1913), conductor Michel Tabachnik's ensemble focuses on one of the leading composers of modern music: Igor Stravinsky. His first ballet music, Firebird (1910), is a highlight of the concert.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Ravel - Piano Concerto for the left hand And Boléro
programme.desc: Péter Csaba leads the Spanish Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet del Encuentro in this inaugural concert of the Encuentro de Música y Academia de Santander. The program opens with Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the left hand in D major, featuring Uzbekistani-born American pianist Stanislav Ioudenitch as the soloist.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.desc: “Ultraje” é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Uma análise dos factos ocorridos no Porto a 24 de agosto de 1820, o perfil político e socio-económico de uma revolta e as suas implicações, num país sob o domínio estrangeiro com a Corte ausente no Brasil.

programme.title: A Letra: Benjamim - 'Volkswagen'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções. Bejamim estava a começar a sua carreira a solo quando 'Volkswagen' se tornou mais do que uma canção: tornou-se o símbolo de uma digressão singular realizada para apresentar o álbum 'Auto Rádio' (2015).

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: 'Minha Terra, Minha Gente' apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal.

programme.title: Ultraje: Traje De Festa Dos Tabuleiros - Tomar
programme.desc: 'Ultraje' é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Em cada episódio, percorremos o país para descobrir os trajes típicos que contam histórias de outras gerações, mergulhando nas tradições, costumes e festas que lhes dão vida. Mais do que roupa, são símbolos de orgulho, resistência e pertença — preservados por homens e mulheres que mantêm viva a memória coletiva.

programme.title: Documentário: Telhados De Vidro - Casa
programme.desc: A 28 de Janeiro de 2026, Portugal foi assolado por uma tempestade com graves consequências materiais e humanas, com o país tendo-se mobilizado para a região de Leiria num movimento de voluntariado nacional sem precedentes. Três meses depois, quais as sequelas que Kristin deixou?

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: Entre O Caos E A Terra - Quinta Da Boavista
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.'De Gente And De Vinha acompanha uma família que encontrou neste lugar o seu pouso definitivo, entre vinhas, memórias e gestos que se repetem no tempo.Há lugares onde o tempo não passa - escuta-se.

programme.title: Documentário: Raiz De Bruma
programme.desc: 'Raiz de Bruma' refere-se principalmente ao documentário histórico 'Raiz de Bruma - Cerveira, 700 anos a fazer história', que narra as origens e a evolução de Vila Nova de Cerveira, Portugal, destacando testemunhos, monumentos e tradições locais. O filme celebra os 700 anos da carta do foral atribuída pelo Rei D. Dinis, explorando mitos e a cultura local.

programme.title: A Letra: Ana Bacalhau - Imperial É Fino
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções.Ana Bacalhau gosta desta canção porque celebra as mil diferenças que compõem Portugal, neste caso Lisboa e Porto, mas há esperança que volte com outros sotaques e dialectos. Foi mais facil falar desta letra da Capicua, do que das suas, e assim se safou, entusiasmando-nos com este desafio.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 56
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 113
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 80
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Ramón Valle And Reinier Baas - Music Meeting 2020
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. Disrupted by COVID-19, the festival’s 2020 edition had to adapt to new challenges.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, DPW
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Here's that rainy day
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Bixiga 70 - BIRD 2019
programme.desc: Stemming from Brazil's São Paulo, Bixiga 70 is an exciting brass and percussion-based instrumental dance ensemble that combines jazz, funk, and Afro-Brazilian music, incorporating elements from dub, reggae, electronics, cumbia, carimbo, Ethio-jazz, and samba. The name Bixiga 70 is taken from a vibrant neighbourhood in downtown São Paulo.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Eli Paperboy Reed
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Portrait: Torino Jazz Festival
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: I Own the Night
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music.

programme.title: Jazz in Comblain-la-Tour, 1963
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith’s All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bill Laurance Project
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Apasionado
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Clair de Lune
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baptiste Trontignon
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, Cuban pianist and vocalist Roberto Fonseca performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Someone You Thought You Knew T2 - Ep. 6

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Conheça a face oculta do mal nos locais de trabalho, onde rivalidades, romances e abusos de poder culminam em mortes brutais. Temos mesmo de conhecer os nossos colegas.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Conheça a face oculta do mal nos locais de trabalho, onde rivalidades, romances e abusos de poder culminam em mortes brutais. Temos mesmo de conhecer os nossos colegas.

programme.title: Shadow of Doubt T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma popular chefe claque de liceu esgueira-se de sua casa pela janela, depois de ter discutido com a sua mãe. Dias depois, o seu corpo é encontrado a flutuar num rio.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma comunidade fica em choque quando um bom pai é encontrado brutalmente assassinado na sua própria cama. Como é que a polícia conseguirá seguir a pista de um assassinato tão improvável?.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning T1 - Ep. 4

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 7

programme.title: What Happened At Fells Acres?

programme.title: What Happened To Valentino Dixon?

programme.title: Na Rota Do Tráfico Com Mariana Van Zeller T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mariana investiga o fenómeno global dos assaltos a carros blindados, responsáveis por alguns dos roubos mais ousados e perigosos do mundo.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Tráfico Com Mariana Van Zeller T5 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Mariana investiga as milícias fortemente armadas dos Estados Unidos e a sua influência crescente.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Tráfico Com Mariana Van Zeller T5 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Mariana investiga os vigaristas que atraem toxicodependentes para centros de reabilitação fraudulentos, enquanto faturam milhões em programas de saúde com tratamentos falsos.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Tráfico Com Mariana Van Zeller T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Mariana investiga uma onda de violência anti-LGBTQ+ e descobre uma rede global bem financiada que promove uma agenda anti-gay em todo o mundo.

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Terra protege-se do sol. A história de David e Golias da relação da Terra com a sua maior ameaça, o nosso aparentemente benigno Sol. O Sol é o chefe grande e violento do Sistema Solar, atirando partículas devastadoras e radiação letal. Sem vários escudos, um gerado pelo nosso núcleo planetário único, outro pela nossa atmosfera e um terceiro pelos sistemas atmosféricos interligados, a vida na Terra nunca poderia acontecer. .

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O nosso calhau é especial - está vivo. Embora os constituintes da vida sejam comuns pelo universo fora, a vida é rara. Então o que há de especial no planeta Terra? Que forças dinâmicas, que coincidências pegaram numa série de ingredientes mortos e os transformaram em algo altamente complexo como a vida? E se aconteceu aqui, poderá acontecer noutro lado? .

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Não chega que a Terra seja habitável, também tem de ser letal para que a vida prospere. A morte está ligada a tudo, desde as nossas células ao próprio planeta. As extinções globais em massa criam oportunidades que a evolução aproveita; potenciando a biodiversidade necessária para sobreviver o que quer que o planeta lhe reserve.

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O Astronauta Chris Hadfield já deixou o planeta três vezes, mas quer fazer mais ainda. Após ver buracos provocados por asteróides na superfície da terra, Chris acredita que a nossa única hipótese de sobrevivência se encontra em colónias fora do nosso planeta. Mas será a viagem mais exigente que a humanidade alguma vez enfrentará: radiação, microgravidade, e bactérias.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Alguma vez escorregou no gelo e se perguntou porquê? Alguma vez ficou perplexo pela sua falha ao atirar um Frisbee ou passou algumas noites sem dormir a pensar porquee é que o seu salto de BMX acabou numa visita o hospital? Bem, a ajuda está a postos quando Richard Hammond regressa para uma segunda temporada de Science of Stupid.

programme.title: De Polo A Polo Com Will Smith T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Will, que sempre teve medo de aranhas, aventura-se nas profundezas da Amazónia equatoriana numa expedição em busca de criaturas perigosas. Acompanhado pelo professor Bryan Fry e pela alpinista local Carla Perez, desce em rappel cerca de 60 metros até uma rede de grutas conhecida como o “ventre da Terra”, onde descobrem uma tarântula gigante.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. Um comboio desgovernado em Paris que choca contra um comboio superlotado, matando 56 pessoas. Dois passadiços suspensos num hotel em Kansas City que colapsam sobre uma pista de dança sobrelotada. Um apagão devastador que paralisa o aeroporto mais movimentado da Europa e afeta dezenas de milhares de pessoas.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. A explosão a bordo do vaivém espacial Challenger, que matou todos os astronautas. A falha do teleférico de Stresa, que deixou apenas um sobrevivente – um menino de cinco anos. E, ainda, o colapso do teto de uma pista de gelo em Bad Reichenhall durante as férias de inverno, que caiu sobre famílias de patinadores.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. O naufrágio de um ferry grego que matou 80 pessoas. Uma explosão colossal numa fábrica química que destruiu totalmente as instalações e devastou um subúrbio francês. O colapso súbito de uma grande ponte rodoviária nos EUA, que fez cair 17 veículos no rio Mississippi e causou 13 mortes.

programme.title: Grandes Máquinas Do Mar T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Num estaleiro de desmantelamento no Lago Erie, um cargueiro dos Grandes Lagos, danificado por um incêndio, chega para a sua última missão. Uma equipa familiar trabalha contra o tempo para tornar o navio seguro, desmantelá-lo para aproveitar o aço e transformar o risco em lucro, enquanto a volatilidade dos preços da sucata, as margens reduzidas e os perigos ambientais condicionam cada decisão. .

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Uma tempestade inesperada força Colbert a abandonar a expedição de pesca, uma reparação de tecto transforma-se num teste para as mulas de Derik, Thorn parte para a caça a meio da noite e a fonte de água de Tobias está a desaparecer. .

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O projecto de Tony e Amelia fica fora de controlo, as mulas turbulentas de Derik escapam do curral, Thorn é engenhoso com uma morte por atropelamento. A fonte de água de Tobias fica seca e Colbert tem que trabalhar lesionado para terminar a sua cabine. .

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Tony e Amelia apressam-se para salvar as suas abelhas, Tobias tenta controlar uma enorme fogueira, Colbert termina uma fase crítica da sua cabine e Tobias constrói um abrigo para o proteger do duro deserto. .

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O ferreiro Derik tem que ser engenhoso para levar as suas mulas para casa, o carpinteiro Thorn tenta apanhar lagostim, o nómada Tobias está desesperado por proteína e os caseiros Tony e Amelia lidam com o excesso de coelhos. .

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A canoa de 20 anos de Colbert deu o seu último suspiro, Tobias faz outra tentativa desesperada de encontrar proteína no seu novo campo, Tobias tem que enfrentar o seu tecto com infiltrações antes que o bolor surja e Tony e Amelia estão concentrados num camião - mas seguindo a sua filosofia de reciclar e reutilizar, não é qualquer velho camião que funciona. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Com o inverno a aproximar-se, Bre e Oliver vão em busca de salmão e Sam vai caçar veados. Entretanto, Curly lança o último isco de pesca da temporada e Mary procura lenha. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Sam e Carl ajudam Matt a fazer reparações no barco a que chama casa. Curly ajuda Bre e Oliver a proteger árvores aquáticas. Squibb contstrói um abrigo de madeira essencial para Troy e Mary faz reparações num passadiço perigoso. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Sam faz algumas reparações muito necessárias ao passadiço comunitário. Curly tenta impedir os castores de invadir as estradas. Squibb e Matt ajudam uma vizinha que precisa de lenha. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Com o inverno a instalar-se, Sam e Matt vão numa caçada de pai e filho e enfrentam condições atmosféricas adversas na sua última missão em busca de veados. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: À medida que a comunidade de Port Protection prospera, Squibb e Troy unem esforços para consertar um barco que se está a afundar e que pode causar um grande derramamento de óleo.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Quando uma árvore submersa bloqueia o canal local, Matt Carlson usa o seu barco e uma corda para puxar o tronco até lugar seguro. Curly avista um urso.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Curly e Mary tentam apanhar caranguejos. Sam e os filhos vão pescar. Troy ajuda Oliver e Breanna a erguer a casa. Carl e Morgan ensinam Veronica a sobreviver.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando uma das únicas linhas telefónicas da cidade que permite comunicar com o exterior fica inoperacional, a recém-chegada Veronica Arrants intervém para provar o que vale.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Sobreviver À Amazónia T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Agora na última parte do seu desafio, Hazen atravessa quilómetros de pântano cheio de cobras para chegar ao Oceano Atlântico. Com a ajuda do povo Warau, Hazen aprende como viver da água e a enfrentar abelhas assassinas.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Hazen Audel parte para realizar o sonho de toda uma vida de fazer uma caminhada pelo lendário Grande Vale do Rift, na África Oriental. Talvez na maior “meca” da vida selvagem a nível mundial, Audel fará uma viagem de 800 quilómetros através de uma natureza selvagem diversificada na época de migração, sobrevivendo ao ar livre entre animais raros e magníficos.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Na segunda etapa da sua viagem através do Grande Vale do Rift, Hazen desce a íngreme parede ocidental do vale em busca de uma venerada manada de elefantes. Aproveitando as capacidades de sobrevivência de uma tribo local, dirige-se a um grupo de pescadores que conhecem bem os elefantes. Com a ajuda deles, segue a manada até às margens do rio Kerio.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Nesta parte do safari africano extremo de Hazen Audel, ele enfrenta o grandioso Lago Baringo. O seu objetivo é vislumbrar milhões de flamingos migratórios.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Hazen Audel viaja até ao desfiladeiro de Hell’s Gate em busca do rinoceronte negro. Forrageiros florestais enviam-no para uma rede de grutas profundas em busca destas criaturas magníficas.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Hazen Audel enfrenta o oceano Índico, numa batalha para chegar a uma rede de cavernas corais costeiras, o lar da maior colónia de morcegos de África.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No Mississippi, agentes aduaneiros mandam parar veículos suspeitos de transportar produtos ilícitos. Na Florida, revistam uma embarcação vinda da Jamaica. Em San Juan, passageiros tentam entrar ilegalmente no país com medicamentos.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Em Atlanta, a polícia detém um homem intercetado com 100 quilos de marijuana, enquanto agentes de San Diego enfrentam um grupo agressivo de possíveis traficantes.

programme.title: Engenharia: Aprender Com A Catástrofe T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Enviar seres humanos para o espaço é perigoso. Os astronautas suportam lançamentos potentes, forças brutais de reentrada e um ambiente onde pequenos erros causam catástrofes. Para preparar a Orion para o espaço profundo, a NASA estuda desastres do passado para conceber fatos, sistemas de evacuação e materiais mais seguros.

programme.title: Engenharia: Aprender Com A Catástrofe T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os túneis poupam tempo, dinheiro e o ambiente ao oferecerem atalhos através de terrenos difíceis. Por outro lado, também podem ser perigosos, especialmente tendo em conta que os túneis de hoje são cada vez mais longos e profundos. Acompanhe o Túnel de Base do Brenner e a ligação do Fehmarnbelt para explorar como os engenheiros usam desastres do passado para tornar a construção e as viagens mais seguras.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: George, o gerente de serviço, é confrontado com uma embalagem suspeita. A novata Mel acode a 2 emergências médicas. Uma carga volumosa coloca a equipa de bagagens à prova.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Este é um dia difícil para Kevin, o Gerente de Bagagem, com 3 falhas de sistema. A equipa de segurança segue o rasto de um homem que viaja com com armas de fogo e a polícia verifica uma mala suspeita.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um avião em rota de aproximação foi atingido várias vezes por relâmpagos. Os técnicos verificam os danos enquanto os passageiros ficam cada vez mais agressivos com o avolumar dos atrasos.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Sydney atravessa uma das épocas mais chuvosas de que há registo. Com tempestades violentas a fechar duas pistas, um avião que se aproxima do aeroporto transmite um pedido de socorro ao Centro de Operações integradas. Aparentemente, um homem sofreu um ataque cardíaco a bordo. Conseguirá o avião aterrar nestas condições meteorológicas?

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Alguma vez escorregou no gelo e se perguntou porquê?
